{{Quote|I will assemble a task force and make contact with my informants in the Coruscant underworld.|Jedi Master Plo Koon|<ref name="Sith Hunters" />}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a '''task force''' was set up by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] with the objective of capturing the resurgent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother, [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The strike team consisted of Jedi Masters [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ko Solok]], [[Grohto]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tatsu]], and multiple [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Sith Hunters" />

Solok, Grohto, and Jun-Fan were all slain by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brothers, and the team was ultimately unsuccessful in capturing Maul and Opress.<ref name="Sith Hunters" />
